name: init

test_list.description: Child process: second init is AlreadyInitialised, creates nothing, the first logger keeps working, and a re-init after guard drop is still refused.
Child process: with tui_mode neither stdout nor stderr receives the probe lines, while the file does.
Control: with the console enabled the probe appears on stderr and never on stdout.
A bad filter is BadFilter and the disk is untouched.
Zero capacities, zero rotation, tiny line limit or empty dir are BadConfig.
Dropping the guard writes every pending record to the file.
flush(timeout) returns true only after the lines are in the file.
The TUI and telemetry rings are filled synchronously.
start() twice leaves the global dispatcher unset.
Configured level filters events before any sink.

output_description: Installs the global subscriber once; the guard flushes and joins the drain thread on drop.
